checks.criterion: Transferred source/archive identity and clean baseline are verified.
Compilation and complete invariant suite pass.
Release distribution, documentation, installer, and release-asset audit gates pass.
Installed suite exports exactly match authoring sources and golden v2 scoring totals 100.
Codex subscription authentication passes with OPENAI_API_KEY absent.
Claude subscription authentication passes with API/auth token variables absent.
Real tmux, pane capacity, browser/runtime, and both readiness checks pass.
Codex run adds exactly two panes to the invoking window and creates no detached benchmark session.
Both Codex arm panes visibly change during execution and retain stable run/arm pane IDs.
Codex fast model timings meet 150-second arm and 180-second paired budgets with usage evidence.
Codex automated pipeline reaches awaiting_human_review with two ready live apps.
Claude run proves exactly two same-window panes, visible changing streams, and stable bindings.
Claude fast model timings meet 150-second arm and 180-second paired budgets with usage evidence.
Claude automated pipeline reaches awaiting_human_review with two ready live apps.
Claude and Codex executor/cohort identities remain separate and truthful.
A real priority-picker-v2 run reuses the same two pane IDs through all three model phases.
Terminating an active owned pane/helper leaves no captured provider descendant process.
Interrupted attempt is infrastructure-classified and any retry is a fresh non-overlapping pair.
Both live applications remain ready and reachable after automated reporting and idle preservation.
Real browser journeys and generated visual/accessibility/download/console evidence pass.
Blinded assignments leak no treatment identity and configured independent human reviews are submitted.
Reports contain machine/human/composite results as applicable and benchmark verify passes.
Live stop/restart is truthful and idempotent while blinded mappings remain stable.
Default cleanup preserves; explicit cleanup safely stops processes, closes only owned panes, removes worktrees, and preserves verifiable evidence.
Backlog, docs, help/man, pack state, and actual implementation/evidence are synchronized.
Every passing check references present regular evidence with verified hashes and complete run lineage.
Independent gate reviewer samples raw evidence, reruns checks, finds no unresolved high/critical defect, and decides accept.
